scope: Evaluator-only authored ordinary reference baseline from the stipulated synthetic case. This incomplete archive is neither empirical evidence nor a recommended correct solution. Absence from it supports no global novelty inference.

families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer or staffed desk enters telephone and in-person changes into a single master calendar and issues a clear confirmation.
families.causal_path_or_observable: One update path reduces contradictory reservations and duplicated room expectations.
families.conditions: Keep telephone and in-person access and protect the two public performances.
families.assumptions: The desk can consult the master record and synchronize any public display promptly.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Offer bookings in 60-minute units with longer sessions when available.
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer gives each requesting group its weekly minimum before allocating additional compatible room time.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Shorter basic allocations may accommodate more groups within fixed opening hours.
families.conditions: Honor the weekly access guarantee, existing room capacity, and dated performances.
families.assumptions: Groups can obtain useful practice in the allocated durations and changeovers fit the schedule.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Confirm reservations and release unused time promptly.
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer asks groups to report cancellations and uses an agreed confirmation routine to offer released slots to waiting groups.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Earlier notice turns avoidable empty bookings into usable rehearsal time.
families.conditions: No mandatory digital account or new fee; protect guaranteed weekly access.
families.assumptions: Groups communicate changes reliably and the reminder work fits the administration limit.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Rebuild repeating allocations from acceptable windows and equipment needs.
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer gathers group preferences and piano requirements, then assigns compatible rooms and times across the coming weeks.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Explicit flexibility can move suitable groups away from contested times and preserve scarce equipment access.
families.conditions: Maintain all minimum access commitments within the existing rooms and staffed hours.
families.assumptions: Enough overlapping acceptable windows exist for a workable allocation.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Which requested needs can be served by another time or room?
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer asks each group about acceptable windows, duration, piano need, and unmet rehearsal time.
families.causal_path_or_observable: A demand map distinguishes true capacity shortages from narrow requests and undocumented flexibility.
families.conditions: Use the available contact conversations and preserve nondigital access.
families.assumptions: Contacts represent their groups and can state realistic alternatives.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Why are reserved periods unused and access expectations inconsistent?
families.actor_operation_target: Volunteer compares desk occupancy notes, booking changes, confirmations, and short explanations from affected groups.
families.causal_path_or_observable: The comparison identifies late arrivals, cancellations, communication gaps, or record disagreements.
families.conditions: Keep investigation small enough for the weekly administration allowance.
families.assumptions: Records and participant recollections can explain enough incidents to guide a bounded change.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs
